content:
We're currently checking out a few iPhone 18 Pro accessories we're planning to use ourselves this year, trying to grab them before Friday's delivery cutoff. If I had to choose, Apple's AirTag 2 and the new AirPods Pro 3 (or AirPods 5) are absolutely the best accessories to pair with your iPhone 18 Pro — and that's not even mentioning the world's greatest Polishing Cloth, which is worth picking up too. But this time we want to go deeper — chargers, MagSafe car mounts, cases, wallets, you name it. Here's a rundown of everything below.

iPhone 18 Pro Accessories

  • Chance – Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max
  • Ben – Apple TechWoven Case
  • Michael – Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger
  • Arin – Apple iPhone FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe
  • Ryan – MagSafe Car Mount (Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro)
  • Fernando – Burgundy Picogo Air Ultra-Slim Power Bank
  • Simon – Baseus Enercore 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Adapter
  • Justin – Satechi 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Stand
  • Reinette – Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case
  • Some other recommendations we really love

If you want to charge your brand-new iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max as quickly as possible, you'll need a compatible charging brick. Specifically, you need a charger that supports Adjustable Voltage Supply — and Apple's own offering is the best choice on the market. It's compact and foldable, and can get your iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max up to 50% in just 15 minutes.

Apple's TechWoven case combines a beautiful aesthetic, a grippy texture, anodized aluminum buttons with an excellent feel, and a range of rich colors — all while being made from 100% recycled polyester for an eco-friendly touch.

Anker's compact 3-in-1 wireless charger can power three devices simultaneously through a single portable accessory, with the iPhone getting Qi2 wireless charging that supports MagSafe. It folds down small enough to slip easily into a travel bag — meaning you won't need to lug a bunch of cables and adapters to your hotel — or you can use it to neatly arrange your entire Apple ecosystem on your nightstand or desk. Right now it's nearly 35% off, hitting an all-time low on Amazon.

Apple's FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe has long been a must-have iPhone accessory for minimalists. It can comfortably hold 3 to 4 cards — whether it's your ID, a couple of credit cards, or a hotel key card — perfect for those who don't want to lug around a bulky wallet.

Whenever I'm driving, I want to find a sturdy and secure spot to place my iPhone. ESR's MagSafe car mount is my top pick. You can use the magnetic attachment to securely hold your iPhone 18 Pro or an older model on the mount, and clipping it to your car's air vent is super convenient. The MagSafe car mount not only keeps your iPhone well-protected but also keeps the screen visible, and you can charge simultaneously while driving.

I've always believed that for a MagSafe power bank to be truly practical for everyday carry alongside your iPhone, it should be as thin as possible. Baseus has just released what I consider the perfect MagSafe battery. The Picogo Air is only 0.27 inches thick and weighs just 3.7 ounces. It packs a 5,000mAh battery inside, with 7.5W wireless charging and 22.5W wired input support. Best of all, it's already available in a colorway that perfectly complements the new phone's burgundy shade (iPhone Burgundy). This is exactly how a truly thin-first MagSafe battery should be made.

If you're always on the move, you'll understand that keeping your tech bag organized is already half the battle. That's why I'm always on the lookout for versatile charging solutions. This Baseus travel adapter is just my style — it supports outlets in over 200 countries and is designed to charge up to six devices at once. But for me, the highlight is the built-in 70W retractable USB-C cable, which can fast-charge your iPhone 18 Pro at full speed while simultaneously delivering stable charging output to your iPad, MacBook, and other devices.

Michael up top picked what I personally consider the best travel-friendly foldable MagSafe charger, but I'm focusing on two of my favorite desktop 3-in-1 models: the ultra-stylish, clean-looking 25W Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Stand in a gorgeous space black; and Anker's Smart Display 3-in-1, which I also love — but the Satechi is just so classy and elegant that it's unbeatable.

After dropping a fortune on an iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, I usually go for more budget-friendly accessories rather than top-of-the-line options. Spigen has plenty of affordable MagSafe cases. My top pick, priced well below other brands, is the clear Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case — there are also non-transparent multi-color versions available, all MagSafe-compatible for fast wireless charging. These cases also feature side TPU panels infused with DuraClear blue resin to prevent yellowing, with shock-absorbing design; notably, the camera control button surface is also covered with a thin layer of TPU.

  • AirTag 2
  • Anker 100W USB-C Smart Display Charger
  • Beats Braided USB-C Cable
  • All-new Pitaka Burgundy Aramid Fiber iPhone 18 Pro Case
  • Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Leather Case
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Shock-Resistant Case
  • Twelve South Butterfly 2-in-1
  • Nomad Find My Tracking Card
